invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null iterator, as Collections.singletonList(...).iterator() never returns null.
The result is an iterator over a singleton list, so it always has at least one element.
partitionPath is passed directly to HoodieCreateHandle, which would likely fail if null; typical invariant for partition path values.
fileId is required as a unique identifier and is passed directly to the handle; null would likely produce an error.
recordMap is required and is used immediately in the handle, so it must be non-null to avoid errors.
